title: Find the Closest Marked Node
summary: Given a directed weighted graph with n nodes, an edge list, a starting node s, and a list of marked nodes, find the shortest path from s to any marked node.
statement: Given a directed weighted graph with n nodes, an edge list, a starting node s, and a list of marked nodes, find the shortest path from s to any marked node. Return the distance or -1 if no path exists to any marked node.
constraints: Each edge [u,v,w] is directed from u to v with positive weight w.
Starting at node s, find the shortest distance to any node listed in marked.
Return -1 when no marked node is reachable.
hints: This is a multi-target shortest-path problem with nonnegative edges.
Run Dijkstra from s and keep marked nodes in a set.
Return as soon as a marked node is removed from the priority queue at its finalized distance.
Dijkstra pops nodes in nondecreasing shortest distance, so the first finalized marked node is the closest one.
editorial: Dijkstra pops nodes in nondecreasing shortest distance, so the first finalized marked node is the closest one.
